testcase.name: a handler blocked on one connection does not delay a request on another
the server rejects requests that break the endpoint rules
an incomplete request is closed after the read timeout
an authorized POST reaches the handler and gets 200 JSON
at the connection cap a new connection evicts one waiting on its client
stop() returns promptly with idle keep-alive connections and releases the port
with every connection dispatched a new connection takes an overflow place, and beyond it is closed
